PET RIDER

This Rider is attached to and made part of the Lease dated March 1, 2026 between Example Realty LLC ("Landlord") and the Tenant named below, for Apartment 4B at 155 East 92nd Street, New York, NY 10128 (the "Premises").

1. Tenant may keep one cat at the Premises. No other animals are permitted without Landlord's written consent.
2. Tenant is responsible for any damage the animal causes to the Premises. Such damage may be deducted from the security deposit as permitted by law.
3. If the animal causes a nuisance, Landlord may require its removal on 30 days' written notice.

All other terms of the Lease remain in effect.
